pricing.source: Verified 2026-11-04 against docs.anthropic.com pricing (Sonnet 5 = $2/$10 per MTok, cache read $0.20, 5-min cache write $2.50) and the repository's ai_pricing.py, which is the same table record_api_usage bills against. Sonnet 4.6 and Haiku 4.5 base rates were already correct; their cache rates now use ai_pricing.py's 0.1x/1.25x multipliers.

C1.rule: Archive all book-authored lettering; analyse narrative, informational and in-scene illustration lettering separately from paratext.

C2.rule: Main narrative, informational and wordless narrative pages participate; bibliographic matter, decorative endpapers, glossary/index and supplemental activities do not.

C3.rule: Names and descriptive referring expressions are lexical aliases; pronouns, body parts and editorial labels are separately retained evidence.

C3_population.rule: Retain individuals, collectives, generic groups and discourse roles in separate strata with unresolved identity.

C4.rule: Keep photographed-edition imprint and publishing house distinct; preserve first-publication and edition events and source evidence.

C5.rule: Existing positives and consistency metrics support exploratory pilot-only claims; dev20 aliases-only recall has ten positives and is a smoke test.

C6.rule: Analytical authors include explicitly credited authors and retellers; retain all original contributor roles.

C7.rule: Also emit bare/short contiguous printed referring heads with full phrase and owner evidence; label embedded_short_form when no independent occurrence exists. Category words must be printed and refer in context. Collective occurrences stay with the collective; membership alone never attaches them to an individual. Ambiguous heads retain alternative candidates.
